title: Reading a recorded tag
statement: For types $Q$ and $T$, a predicate $P$ on an optional state and a tag, an optional state $q$, and an optional Boolean input, define a partial Boolean-valued reader on record symbols: on a tag-cell symbol carrying $\tau$, it returns the Boolean value $P(q,\tau)$ as a present result; on every other record symbol, it returns no result. The supplied optional Boolean parameter does not affect the output.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on an optional state and a tag
The input parameter is an optional Boolean
